title: Attic Ventilation Calculator
benefit: Net Free Area and Vent Count
cardBlurb: Net free area and soffit and ridge vents
metaDescription: Find the attic net free ventilating area the 2021 IRC requires (1/150, or 1/300 under its exception) and how many feet of soffit and ridge vent meet it.
secondaryKeywords: attic ventilation calculator net free area
how much attic ventilation do i need
how much ridge vent do i need
intent: Find the attic net free ventilating area required by code and estimate how many soffit and ridge (or other) vents meet it.
registerRow: Not on the Oct 2026 Keyword Register: category-fill addition (Insulation and Energy) chosen by the redesign brief; vent area and vent counts, not R-value or insulation bags.
intro: Enter your attic floor area to get the net free ventilating area the 2021 IRC requires, split between soffit intake and ridge exhaust, and how much vent meets it.
chartTitle: Required net free area: intake vs exhaust (sq in)
diagramCaption: Attic cross-section: air in at the soffits, out at the ridge. It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: The 2021 IRC R806.2 ratio with the 1/300 exception's 40 to 50% upper-vent condition checked, a local-ratio override, and vent counts from the NFA printed on your own products (defaults cited to Air Vent's continuous soffit and ShingleVent II ridge vent), plus a table for common attic sizes.

inputs.name: atticArea
inputs.label: Attic floor area
inputs.help: Area of the vented attic space (usually the ceiling below it), 50 to 20,000 sq ft.

inputs.name: rule
inputs.label: Ventilation ratio

options.label: 1/300 (only when the exception's conditions are met)

inputs.help: 1/300 is allowed only when its conditions are met; see the FAQ.

inputs.name: exhaustShare
inputs.label: Share from exhaust (upper) vents
inputs.help: 0 to 100%. The 1/300 exception requires 40 to 50%. 50% is an even split between intake and exhaust.

inputs.name: intakeNfa
inputs.label: Intake vent NFA
inputs.help: From the product label: per linear foot for continuous vent, per vent for individual vents. Air Vent lists 9 sq in per ft for its continuous soffit vent.

inputs.name: exhaustNfa
inputs.label: Exhaust vent NFA
inputs.help: From the product label: per linear foot for ridge vent, per vent for box vents. Air Vent lists 18 sq in per ft for ShingleVent II.

sources.title: R806.2 Minimum Vent Area, 2021 International Residential Code (UpCodes): 1/150 of the vented space; 1/300 when the exception's conditions are met, including 40 to 50 percent from upper ventilators
Calculating Attic Passive Ventilation (Building America Solution Center, Pacific Northwest National Laboratory, U.S. Department of Energy)
ShingleVent II ridge vent product sheet (Air Vent): 18 sq in of net free area per linear foot
Air Vent Continuous Aluminum Soffit and Under Eave Vent product listing (Do it Best): 9 sq in of net free area per linear foot
